registration.title: Account creation
registration.open_description: Anyone can create an account using the configured signup methods.
registration.invite_only_description: New accounts need a single-use invitation code. Existing users can still sign in.
registration.methods_configuration: Signup methods are managed in this server’s hosting configuration.
registration.no_methods: No signup methods are enabled. Users cannot create accounts in either mode.

neighbors.title: Neighbors
neighbors.subtitle: Advertise friendly Chatto servers in your public directory
neighbors.origin_help: Enter a server hostname or URL. Chatto stores only its HTTP or HTTPS origin.

members.deactivate_description: The user will no longer be able to use this server. All sessions will end immediately. Their data will remain intact. You can reactivate the account later.
members.deactivated_description: This account is deactivated. Reactivation lets the user sign in again. Old sessions stay invalid.
members.title: Members
members.subtitle: View and manage server members and their roles
members.not_found: Member not found. They may have left the server.
members.cooldown_active: Self-rename cooldown active for this user - {remaining} remaining.
members.never_renamed: User has never changed their username.
members.set_password_description: Set a direct sign-in password for this user. Their existing sessions are revoked.
members.assign_roles_description: Assign roles to this member. Changes are saved immediately.
members.view_roles_description: View the roles assigned to this member.
members.implicit_role_tooltip: All server members have this role implicitly
members.cannot_revoke_own_role: You cannot revoke your own {role} role
members.delete_account_entry_description: Permanently deletes this member's account. Their messages become unreadable. This cannot be undone.
members.bio_placeholder: Tell others a little about this member
members.bio_description: Up to {max} characters, shown on the profile of the member.

member_delete.title: Delete Member
member_delete.warning: This permanently deletes {name}'s account. This cannot be undone.
member_delete.consequence_rooms: The member is removed from all rooms.
member_delete.consequence_messages: All messages they wrote become permanently unreadable.
member_delete.consequence_profile: Their profile, avatar and username are deleted. The username becomes available again.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.subtitle: Manage server-wide role defaults
permissions.role_presets_intro: Roles bundle permissions for groups of users - for example a moderator role that can moderate messages, or a dev team role with access to engineering rooms. Assign roles to members from each user's profile.
permissions.create_role_subtitle: Create a new role for this server
permissions.create_after_hint: After creating the role, you can assign permissions to it on the edit page.
permissions.need_manage_create: You need the roles.manage permission to create roles.
permissions.need_manage_edit: You need the roles.manage permission to edit roles.
permissions.system_metadata_locked: System role metadata cannot be modified.
permissions.everyone_pingable_description: Use @all for room-wide delivery; everyone is not a role ping handle.
permissions.delete_role_description: Deleting this role will remove it from all users who have it assigned.
permissions.owner_permissions_hint: Owners are always granted all permissions. The matrix is read-only because owner permissions are not stored as editable grants or denials.
permissions.role_permissions_hint: This role's grants and denials across every scope. Combined with the user's other roles at resolution time - use the per-user matrix to see what an individual user ends up with.
permissions.everyone_implicit: All server members have the everyone role implicitly.
permissions.server_tier_intro: This page is for server-tier role permissions: broad defaults that apply before room-specific overrides.
permissions.server_tier_rooms_hint: Use Rooms for per-group and per-room overrides.
permissions.resolution_hint: For each user or named role, the nearest room, group, or server value applies. Denies win between them. An allow overrides an everyone deny only at the same or a more specific scope.
permissions.update_ping_failed: Failed to update role ping setting

rooms_admin.title: Rooms
rooms_admin.subtitle: Create, edit, organise, and archive rooms
rooms_admin.group_permissions_subtitle: Per-group role permission grants and denials
rooms_admin.room_permissions_subtitle: Per-room override permissions (layered on top of the room's group)
rooms_admin.group_permissions_hint: Set role permissions for all rooms in this group. These override server defaults. Individual rooms can override these settings.
rooms_admin.room_permissions_hint: These settings apply only in this room. They replace the room group and server settings for the same role or user. To let only some roles do something here, set Deny for everyone and Allow for those roles.
rooms_admin.empty_groups_body: Create a set to start organising rooms.
rooms_admin.drag_hint: Drag rooms between groups to organise them. Drag group headers to reorder groups. Archived rooms stay in their set but are hidden from members.
rooms_admin.delete_group_blocked: Move all items out of this group before deleting
rooms_admin.threading_mode_description: Required always uses threads; Encouraged makes thread reply the primary action; Enabled leaves the choice open; Disabled blocks new thread activity.
rooms_admin.threading_mode_encouraged_description: Threads are encouraged, but not required.
rooms_admin.room_name_trim: Room name cannot have leading or trailing whitespace
rooms_admin.unarchive_room_prompt: Are you sure you want to unarchive #{room}? Members will be able to access it again.
rooms_admin.universal_members_description: Membership is automatic in Universal rooms. Everyone with permission to access this room is included.
rooms_admin.archived_members_description: Membership cannot be changed while this room is archived.
rooms_admin.remove_member_prompt: Remove {name} from {room}? They will no longer be an explicit member of this room.

settings.unsaved_changes: You have unsaved changes. Leave this page and discard them?
settings.name_subtitle: Members see these in the room list and at the top of the room.
settings.membership_events_description: Show when people join or leave this room, including in its history. Hiding this activity does not delete it.
settings.membership_events_unavailable: Update this server to change how membership activity is shown.
settings.visibility_subtitle: Choose who is a member of this room.
settings.universal_description: Every member who can join this room is a member automatically.
settings.visibility_help: Use a Universal room for news that all members must get, such as announcements. Members cannot leave a Universal room, but they can mute it. If you turn Universal off, the members who joined before stay in the room.
settings.slow_mode_subtitle: Limit how often each member can post in this room.
settings.independent_slow_mode_help: Channel slow mode limits new root messages per member. Thread slow mode limits each member separately in each thread. The root starts both timers for its author. Members with room.manage or message.manage permission are exempt. Edits and reactions do not change the timers.
settings.slow_mode_help: One timer covers messages, thread replies, and attachments. Members with the room.manage or message.manage permission are exempt. While members wait, they can still write drafts, edit their messages, and add reactions.
settings.threading_subtitle: Choose how conversations in this room use threads.
settings.threading_help: A change applies only to new messages. Existing threads stay as they are. Required is good for rooms where each message is a separate topic, such as support requests. Encouraged keeps busy rooms easy to read, but does not force threads.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Sign-up restrictions and account protection
security.blocked_usernames_description: One per line. Users cannot register with these names.

oauth_clients.title: OAuth clients
oauth_clients.description: Applications appear here after a member authorises them. Trust is an administrative label and never skips individual consent; blocking prevents new access and revokes existing access tokens.
oauth_clients.empty: No OAuth clients have been authorised

system.subtitle: Broker, JetStream storage, consumers, and projection health
system.asset_cleanup_healthy_summary: All known physical deletion work is complete.
system.asset_cleanup_retrying_summary: One or more deletions will be retried automatically.
system.asset_cleanup_initializing_summary: The elected worker is scanning durable deletion history.
system.asset_cleanup_stalled_summary: The elected worker has stopped reporting progress.
system.asset_cleanup_inactive_summary: No asset cleanup worker currently holds the lease.
system.asset_cleanup_unavailable_summary: Cleanup health is not reported by this server version.
system.account_unavailable: JetStream account usage is not available.
system.jetstream_unavailable: Stream and consumer details are not available.
system.broker_scope_help: This is the broker connection of the Chatto instance that handled this request. If you run more than one instance, the other instances can connect to a different NATS node.

health.title: Health
health.overall_ok_summary: All checks passed when this snapshot was taken.
health.overall_partial_summary: No problems found. Some checks have no data.
health.overall_problem_summary: Review the checks below. Some checks link to a tab with more details.
health.broker_disconnected: Not connected to the NATS broker

usage.title: JetStream Usage
usage.replica_copies_note: Includes a copy on each stream replica. The file streams hold {size} of data.

livekit.title: Calls (LiveKit)
livekit.summary_ok: Chatto can reach the LiveKit server, and LiveKit accepts the API key and secret.
livekit.summary_not_configured: LiveKit is not configured, so voice and video calls are off.
livekit.summary_unreachable: Chatto cannot connect to the LiveKit URL. Make sure that LiveKit runs and that this server can reach the URL.
livekit.summary_unauthorized: LiveKit rejected the API key or secret. Make sure that they match a key pair in the LiveKit configuration.
livekit.summary_error: The server at the LiveKit URL sent an unexpected reply. Make sure that the URL points to LiveKit.
livekit.insecure_url: The LiveKit URL uses ws:// or http://, which is not encrypted. Browsers on an HTTPS page cannot connect to it. Use wss:// when other computers use this server.
livekit.webhooks_rejected: The last webhook from LiveKit had a signature that is not valid. Make sure that LiveKit signs webhooks with the same API key and secret as Chatto.
livekit.no_webhooks: This server has not received a webhook from LiveKit since it started. LiveKit sends webhooks only when calls start or change. If calls ran during this time, make sure that LiveKit sends webhooks to the webhook URL below.
livekit.scope_help: Webhook times come from the Chatto instance that handled this request. Chatto cannot check TURN relays.
livekit.turn_guide: Read about TURN for networks that block calls

event_log.title: Event Log
event_log.subtitle: Browse the durable event-sourcing stream (EVT). Read-only - useful for debugging and as a starting point for the audit log.
event_log.subject: Subject
event_log.filtered_scan: Filtered scan inspected {limit} retained events and may have older matches outside that window.

invitations.management_help: Invite codes let other people join this server.
invitations.note_placeholder: For Alex from the design team
invitations.note_description: You and invitation managers can see this note.
invitations.usage: New codes expire after 7 days and admit one account each. Copy a code and send it to its recipient. A code is used only when signup succeeds.
invitations.revoke_description: This code will stop admitting new accounts immediately.
